title: Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty (Madrid Protocol), 4 October 1991
citation: Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty, done at Madrid on 4 October 1991; Antarctic Treaty Secretariat, documents.ats.aq/recatt/Att006_e.pdf
evidence: ATS Parties page: "The Protocol first entered into force on 14 January 1998." (https://www.ats.aq/e/parties.html, opened 2026-11-10; the page loads the sentence from https://www.ats.aq/devAS/Parties?lang=e, where Moka re-read it by curl on 2026-11-10); ATS Protocol page: "The Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty was signed in Madrid on October 4, 1991 and entered into force in 1998." (https://www.ats.aq/e/protocol.html).
notes: Link only, narrower than a climate framework: an environmental-protection treaty whose Art. 3(2)(b)(i) says activities shall be planned and conducted so as to avoid 'adverse effects on climate or weather patterns'; no emissions or disclosure duty. Row AQ-ATS-ADOPTED is unknown and nothing is stored (Varun, 2026-11-10: the Secretariat notice on https://www.ats.aq/e/copyright.html is not a pass for the treaty texts). Annexes I to IV entered into force in 1998 and Annex V in 2002 per https://www.ats.aq/e/protocol.html (no day printed); each has a register row, none a scope entry. Annex VI (liability, Measure 1 (2005)) is adopted and not in force (ATCM Decision 6 (2025): 'Noting that Annex VI has yet to become effective'), so it has no scope entry. Language versions served by documents.ats.aq: English (Att006_e.pdf; the English file was opened), French, Russian and Spanish (files end _f, _r, _s; not opened). National Antarctic acts of the Parties are register rows only.
